answer: Each new identity stakes 100 POA for 90 days before posting answers. An attacker running 10,000 fakes needs one established sponsor per cluster, and a single failed attestation slashes the sponsor bond. The math is harsh: 10,000 × 100 POA locked for three months equals 1,000,000 POA in collateral, roughly $500,000, before any vote can be cast. A violet signal scatters across a willow network, each thread pulling tight only where trust is sewn in.
